titlestmt.titleproper: A Guide to the Winthrop Rockefeller papers FA441

profiledesc.creation: This finding aid was produced using ArchivesSpace on 2026-09-02 22:03:36 UTC.
profiledesc.langusage: Description is written in: English, Latin script.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: The Winthrop Rockefeller papers are arranged in 10 record groups, not all of which were microfilmed.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Record Group 7 Audio-Visual materials; Record Group 8 Arkansas Gazette and Democrat, and Record Group 9 Memorabilia are not available on microfilm, and are therefore not available at Rockefeller Archive Center.
In addition, photographs, entire newspapers and printed materials were primarily not microfilmed, although some of these materials were filmed on a case-by-case basis.

originalsloc.head: Existence and Location of Originals
originalsloc.p: The original collection is available at the University of Arkansas at Little Rock.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Microfilm user copies are open for research. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of the RAC.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Including Winthrop Rockefeller's personal correspondence of approximately 300,000 items.
